topics.name: http
topics.when: Writing or changing an HTTP entrypoint or its test: get/put/patch/post/del, wildcards, request and response shapes, rawBody for signed webhooks, getBearer, acceptForwardedAttribution, error helpers, request() and withBearer in tests, methods and paths.

topics.name: events-and-timers
topics.when: Writing or changing an event handler (on) or a scheduled job (setInterval), or their tests with emit and clockStrikes.

topics.name: context
topics.when: Using the handler context: context.emit and its attributes, context.log levels, context.now, context.env, httpRequestHeaders, event filters on on(), objectSpreadable, arraySpreadable, missing.

topics.name: testing
topics.when: Asserting what a handler emitted or logged, moving the clock or setting environment variables in a test: getEmitted, getEmittedEnvelopes, getLoggedEntries, timeShift, freezeTime, setEnvironment, mocking a provider.
